_help: Paid placements shown above the product list. Edit, commit and push to main (the site redeploys). 'states' empty = everywhere. 'starts'/'ends' are YYYY-MM-DD and optional. Only https: and mailto: links are allowed. Remove 'example' (and the placeholder text) when you sign a real sponsor. First eligible placement wins.

placements.headline: Put your beer at the top of the list
placements.body: This is an example sponsored placement. Craft brewers and distributors can promote a beer to people comparing prices in their state, clearly labelled as paid.
